name: AI Chief of Staff — Daily Executive Briefing

parameters.content:
## SETUP CHECKLIST
1. "Get Yesterday's Orders", "Get Inventory Levels", "Get Ad Insights" nodes: add your Shopify Admin API token and Meta Marketing API token (same credentials you already use in your other workflows).
2. "Low Stock Threshold" inside the code node: default flags anything under 10 units — adjust to your reorder point.
3. HTTP Request node (Claude): add your Anthropic API key.
4. Email node: set toEmail to yourself (or whoever runs the business day-to-day).
5. Schedule: runs daily at 7am by default — set it earlier than your other digests so this lands first.

## WHAT THIS ACTUALLY DOES
Most of your other workflows report ONE thing (ad alerts, trend digest, etc). This one pulls sales + inventory + ad performance together in a single pass and has Claude write it up like a COO briefing a founder — state of the business, what's working, what needs attention, and 3 ranked actions for today. It's the one email worth reading first each morning.

## OPTIONAL UPGRADE
If you start logging your trend digest or flagged ad campaigns to a Google Sheet instead of just emailing them, you can feed that sheet into this workflow too so the briefing gets even richer over time.
